articles.summary: Prediction markets are growing fast, but deposit friction is the biggest bottleneck to mainstream adoption. Here's how the best platforms are solving it.
articles.title: Prediction Markets Deserve Better Deposit Infrastructure

articles.summary: Alpha Arcade is the #3 prediction market by weekly transactions — and it runs on Algorand. During Super Bowl LX, Unifold solved the hardest deposit problem in crypto: getting funds onto a chain that most providers won't touch.
articles.title: How Unifold Powered Alpha Arcade's Super Bowl Moment
